2. Ensure the controller handle is initialized before calling the SDK functions.

Fixes #55595

This issue has been marked as stale because it has been open (more than) 60 days with no activity. Remove the stale label or add a comment saying that you would like to have the label removed otherwise this issue will automatically be closed in 14 days. Note, that you can always re-open a closed issue at any time.
I found the issue also exists on the RT1050

The issue is that earlier in the test the `usb_dc_reset` function sets the `dev_state.dev_struct.controllerHandle` to `NULL`, and the ehci0 SDK driver, unlike the LPC3511IP, checks if the controller handle argument is NULL and errors out if so. for some reason this is not an issue for the lpc3511ip  usb driver and so the test passes for it but not the ehci usb platforms. I do not know enough about the USB to know why these things are the case. @mmahadevan108 do you know why we set the handle to null in the reset function?

review_comments: just wondering why do we check for this here now?
The test is calling `usb_dc_ep_disable` before the endpoint is initialized which is a valid scenario.
